title: WASSP: Get rid of bogus tree-is-NULL test
description:
Whether to call another dissector should never depend on whether
the tree is NULL or not. That causes, e.g., the entries in the
packet list columns to change depending on whether there is a
custom column or not.

commits_data.message:
WASSP: Get rid of bogus tree-is-NULL test

Whether to call another dissector should never depend on whether
the tree is NULL or not. That causes, e.g., the entries in the
packet list columns to change depending on whether there is a
custom column or not.
